name: Soft crossfade + whoosh
oneliner: 8-frame crossfades with a soft whoosh on every scene change.
description: Turns hard jumps into gentle transitions with a matching sound. Polished, never flashy.
prompt: At every cut between non-continuous shots (b-roll in and out, section changes), use an 8-frame crossfade at 30fps (about 267ms) with a subtle 4% scale dip-and-return; keep jump cuts inside the talking head as hard cuts. Lay a soft whoosh SFX centered on each transition, peaking around -20 LUFS and ducked under speech; rotate between 2-3 whoosh samples so it never sounds repetitive. At most one transition every 2s. Do NOT use spin, glitch or page-curl transitions and do NOT land a whoosh on top of a speech peak.
